description: Claude Code on your Claude subscription, as VS Code's AI: chats, projects, artifacts, design, memory and MCP, with everything stored on this machine.
untrustedWorkspaces: LocalClaude runs Claude Code, which reads and edits files and runs commands in your workspace.
config.browserPath: Program file of the Chromium-based browser (Edge, Chrome, Chromium or Brave) used to export designs as PDF or PNG. Leave empty to find one automatically.
config.includeEditorContext: Tell Claude which file is open in the editor, what is selected and which other files are open, with every message (not shown in the chat).
